Item 8.01

Other Events 

On November 25, 2026, FirstEnergy Corp. (the “Company”) entered into sales agreements (each, a “Sales Agreement” and collectively, the “Sales Agreements”) with each of Barclays Capital Inc., BofA Securities, Inc., BTIG, LLC (or, in its capacity as forward seller, BNY Mellon Capital Markets, LLC (acting through BTIG, LLC as agent)), CIBC World Markets Corp., Citigroup Global Markets Inc., J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, KeyBanc Capital Markets Inc., Mizuho Securities USA LLC, Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, MUFG Securities Americas Inc., PNC Capital Markets LLC, RBC Capital Markets, LLC, Scotia Capital (USA) Inc., TD Securities (USA) LLC, Truist Securities, Inc. and Wells Fargo Securities, LLC (each, an “Agent” and collectively, the “Agents” and in such capacity as applicable, each a “Forward Seller” and collectively, the “Forward Sellers”), and Barclays Bank PLC (through its agent Barclays Capital Inc.), Bank of America, N.A., The Bank of New York Mellon, Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (through its agent CIBC World Markets Corp.), Citibank, N.A., JPMorgan Chase Bank, National Association, KeyBanc Capital Markets Inc., Mizuho Markets Americas LLC (through its agent Mizuho Securities USA LLC), Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, MUFG Securities EMEA plc, Royal Bank of Canada (through its agent RBC Capital Markets, LLC), The Bank of Nova Scotia (through its agent Scotia Capital (USA) Inc.), The Toronto-Dominion Bank (through its agent TD Securities (USA) LLC), Truist Bank and Wells Fargo Bank, National Association (each, a “Forward Purchaser and, collectively, the “Forward Purchasers”), with respect to the offering and sale from time to time of shares of the Company’s common stock, par value $0.10 per share (“Common Stock”), having an aggregate offering price of up to $1,000,000,000 (the “Shares”), in amounts and at times to be determined by the Company. 

Subject to the terms and conditions of the Sales Agreements, each of the Agents and the Forward Sellers will use commercially reasonable efforts to sell on the Company’s behalf or, in the case of a Forward Seller, on behalf of the relevant Forward Purchaser, any Shares as instructed by the Company. Sales of the Shares, if any, made under the Sales Agreements may be made by any method permitted by applicable law and deemed to be an “at the market offering” as defined in Rule 415 under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”), including sales made by means of ordinary brokers’ transactions through the facilities of the New York Stock Exchange at market prices, to or through a market maker, through an electronic communications network, in negotiated transactions, in any manner permitted by applicable law, or as otherwise agreed between the Company and any Agent or Forward Seller. 

The Company may also enter into one or more forward sale agreements under separate forward sale confirmations (each, together with any related pricing supplements, a “Forward Sale Agreement” and collectively, the “Forward Sales Agreements”) with the relevant Forward Purchaser. In connection with each Forward Sale Agreement, the applicable Forward Purchaser or its affiliate will, at the Company’s request, borrow from third parties and, through its affiliated Forward Seller, sell a number of Shares equal to the number of Shares underlying the particular Forward Sale Agreement. 

In no event will the aggregate number of Shares sold through the Agents or the Forward Sellers under the Sales Agreements and under any Forward Sale Agreement have an aggregate sales price in excess of $1,000,000,000. The Company has no obligation to offer or sell any Shares under the Sales Agreements and may at any time suspend offers and sales under the Sales Agreements. 

The Company will not initially receive any proceeds from the sale of borrowed shares of its Common Stock by the Forward Sellers. The Company expects to receive proceeds from the sale of Shares upon future physical settlement of the relevant Forward Sale Agreement, in which case the Company would expect to receive aggregate net cash proceeds at settlement equal to the number of Shares underlying the particular Forward Sale Agreement multiplied by the relevant forward sale price. If the Company elects to cash settle or net share settle a Forward Sale Agreement, it may not (in the case of cash settlement) or will not (in the case of net share settlement) receive any proceeds, and the Company may owe cash (in the case of cash settlement) or Shares (in the case of net share settlement) to the relevant Forward Purchaser. 

Each Agent will receive from the Company a commission of up to 1.0% of the gross sales price per share for any Shares sold by it under the applicable Sales Agreement. In connection with each Forward Sale Agreement, the relevant Forward Seller will receive, in the form of a reduced initial forward sale price under the related Forward Sale Agreement, a commission of up to 1.0% of the volume weighted average of the gross sales prices of all borrowed shares sold during the applicable forward hedge selling period by it as Forward Seller. 

The Company expects to use the net proceeds, if any, from the issuance and sale of the Shares for (i) the repayment, redemption or refinancing of existing indebtedness, (ii) general corporate purposes, or (iii) any combination of the foregoing. All of the Agents, either directly or through affiliates, are lenders under the Company’s revolving credit facilities and accordingly may receive a portion of the proceeds from the offering pursuant to the repayment of borrowings under such credit facilities. 

The offer and sale of the Shares have been registered under the Securities Act pursuant to a Registration Statement on Form 
S-3,
 as amended (Registration 
No. 333-296357),
 which became effective on June 15, 2026, as supplemented by the Prospectus Supplement dated November 25, 2026 relating to the Shares, which was filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission under Rule 424(b) of the Securities Act on November 25, 2026. 

The foregoing description of the form of Sales Agreement set forth in this Item 8.01 does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the form of Sales Agreement (which includes as Exhibit A thereto the form of Forward Confirmation) filed as Exhibit 1.1 hereto and is incorporated herein by reference.
